purpose: Pinned sha256 of the gitignored native sandbox assets a fresh runtime checkout does NOT carry (native/system/.gitignore ignores every platform package bin/). tests/world-factory/lib/host-sandbox-assets.mjs provisions them over TWO transports and refuses to publish any file whose bytes do not hash to this table: (1) a LOCAL copy from a trusted runtime tree, (2) the pinned PUBLISHED npm package (packages block below), fetched as a tarball and verified against the registry's dist.integrity AND the pinned tarball sha256 before a byte is installed.
transport: two transports, one pin: (a) local copy from a trusted LOCAL runtime tree (no network; the default, and it never overwrites bytes it did not create); (b) pinned published package tarball - exact name@version only, fetched from the npm registry, verified against the registry's published dist.integrity (sha512) and against the tarballSha256 pinned below, then per-file sha256+length+mode checked before install. The package transport exists because a hosted runner's own host build produces DIFFERENT bytes for bin/glibc/system.node (measured dfa6d586... vs the pin 54a9c25c...); the FIXED PUBLISHED ASSET is the standard and the sha256 pin is never moved to match a build.
